title: Falkyria Account
intro: Optional: Nicx works fully without an account. With one, you keep an encrypted backup of your assistants, routines, skills, packs and MCP servers and restore it on another PC.
restartServer: The Nicx server is out of date. Restart Nicx to use the account.
genericError: Something went wrong with the account. Try again.
name: Name (optional)
passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers.
protected: The session is protected by Windows on this PC; the password is not stored.

consent.before: I have read and accept the
consent.required: To create the account, accept the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy.
consent.update: The Terms of Use or the Privacy Policy changed. Read and accept them to keep using the account.

backup.title: Backup
backup.intro: Included: assistants, routines, skills, MCP servers (no keys or passwords) and the list of packs. Not included: conversations, memory, notes and files. The backup is encrypted on this PC before it leaves; Falkyria cannot open it. The 5 newest are kept.
backup.warning: The backup password is not the account password and is not stored anywhere. Forget it and the backup is lost.
backup.label: Backup name (optional)
backup.willRestore: This will restore {{summary}}. What already exists on this PC stays as is.

data.title: Your data (LGPD)
data.intro: You can download everything Falkyria keeps about your account or delete the account. Deleting removes the login, profile and all backups, with no way back.
data.deleteWarning: This deletes the account, profile and backups forever. What is on this PC stays here. Type the account password to confirm.

confirmSent: We sent an email to {{email}}. Open the confirmation link (or type the code, if there is one) and then tap "I've confirmed, sign in". Also check spam.
recoverySent: We sent an email to {{email}} with a link to create the new password; it opens in the browser. If you got a code, type it here.
